Interface AcademicEventRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<AcademicEvent, UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AcademicEvent, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<AcademicEvent, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<AcademicEvent, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<AcademicEvent, UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<AcademicEvent>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<AcademicEvent, UUID>
public interface AcademicEventRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AcademicEvent, UUID>
Spring Data JPA repository for AcademicEvent entities. Provides filtered retrieval and deadline-ordered listing for calendar and planner consumers.

  • Method Details

    • findAllFiltered

      @Query("SELECT e FROM AcademicEvent e\nWHERE (:courseId IS NULL OR e.course.id = :courseId)\n AND (:upcoming IS NULL\n OR (:upcoming = true AND e.deadline >= :now))\nORDER BY e.deadline ASC\n") List<AcademicEvent> findAllFiltered(@Param("courseId") Long courseId, @Param("upcoming") Boolean upcoming, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now)
      Retrieves academic events matching optional course and upcoming filters, ordered by deadline ascending.
      Parameters:
      courseId - optional course ID filter; null matches any course
      upcoming - optional filter: true for events with deadline in the future, null for all events
      now - the current timestamp used as the boundary for the upcoming filter
      Returns:
      list of matching events ordered by deadline ascending

    • findByCourseIdOrderByDeadlineAsc

      List<AcademicEvent> findByCourseIdOrderByDeadlineAsc(Long courseId)
      Retrieves all events for a course ordered by deadline ascending. Used by the Planner service to load upcoming rigid constraints.
      Parameters:
      courseId - the course ID to filter by
      Returns:
      events ordered by deadline ascending
